primitives.name: Data Coverage Integral
primitives.verbatim_quote: ## Brutal audit - CRITICAL: active, legally usable data coverage remains smaller than the seeded source universe.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'C(t)': 'Coverage function over time, dimensionless', 'S': 'Seeded source universe size, unitless', 'L(t)': 'Legally usable coverage at time t, unitless'}
primitives.assumptions: Coverage is a monotonically increasing function of time under legal constraints; L(t) ≤ S.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When L(t) approaches zero due to contract expiration or legal infeasibility.

layer2.mapping: GSI computes posterior probability of coverage completeness via Bayesian updating on legal and contractual constraints.
layer2.telemetry: Percentage of seeded sources actively covered by licensed data.

primitives.name: Trust Conflict Resolution
primitives.verbatim_quote: - HIGH: premium UX must explain trust, coverage, conflicts, and missing data in ten seconds.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'T_i': 'Trust score of source i, normalized [0,1]', 'C_{ij}': 'Conflict indicator between sources i and j, binary {0,1}', 'R(t)': 'Resolution rate of conflicts at time t, unitless'}
primitives.assumptions: Trust scores are independent and conflict resolution is deterministic within a bounded time window.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When C_{ij} > 0.5 and R(t) < threshold, leading to UX ambiguity.

layer2.mapping: GSE models trust propagation as a Markov chain over source graphs, resolving conflicts via maximum likelihood estimation.
layer2.telemetry: Average time to resolve conflict in UI, measured in seconds.

primitives.name: Licensed Data Grading
primitives.verbatim_quote: - HIGH: licensed route, pressure, coverage, tracking, PFF-like grades, and trenches data need contracts or first-party charting.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'G_l': 'Grade of licensed data l, normalized [0,1]', 'P_l': 'Pressure metric for data l, unitless', 'T_l': 'Tracking accuracy for data l, unitless'}
primitives.assumptions: Grades are derived from a weighted sum of pressure and tracking metrics, with fixed weights.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When P_l or T_l falls below minimum acceptable thresholds.

layer2.mapping: GSI applies a conformal prediction framework to grade licensed data based on historical consistency and external validation.
layer2.telemetry: Proportion of data points graded above threshold.

As the seeded universe S grows, the gap between L(t) and S widens unless new contracts are secured. Trust conflict resolution emerges as a dual problem to coverage expansion—when multiple sources provide conflicting signals, the system must resolve them quickly to maintain UX integrity. The licensed data grading function G_l synthesizes pressure and tracking into a single metric that reflects data quality. These primitives form a coherent mathematical framework where each operation is grounded in empirical observables and constrained by legal and operational boundaries.
